patch_description: Simulated-annealing optimizer for the 13-point Heilbronn problem. Starts from a quasi-uniform random configuration (seeded, deterministic), then repeatedly perturbs points within the unit square, accepting moves by a Metropolis criterion with decaying temperature. After the main anneal, an adaptive restart re-anneals the best solution with a reheat phase (step reset, short schedule) while always keeping the best-ever configuration as fallback, mitigating greedy-climbing traps. The objective is the exact minimum area over all C(13,3)=286 triangles, computed vectorized. The final configuration is kept in the unit square (a convex region); min_area_normalized is computed against the convex hull area via a small shoelace routine so the result is robust. All randomness flows from a fixed seed for full reproducibility.
